```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(knitr)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Finished careers only: a career still running has no observed ending. The
# season still being played is left out of the careers' last seasons.
complete_through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
store <- file.path(root, "_targets")
outcomes <- targets::tar_read(outcomes, store = store)
ending_status <- career_end_status(
  targets::tar_read(career, store = store),
  outcomes,
  targets::tar_read(picks_nfl, store = store)
)
# Careers with at least one season stat line: the ones a box-score ending can
# be read for.
stat_ids <- unique(outcomes$playerId[outcomes$has_stat_line])
roster <- dbReadTable(con, "roster")
pos_levels <- setdiff(
  harmonized_position_levels(),
  c("Athlete", "Position not recorded")
)
# A career's position is its position in its last roster season.
last_position <- roster |>
  mutate(playerId = as.character(playerId)) |>
  group_by(playerId) |>
  slice_max(season, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(playerId, position_group = harmonize_position(position, "roster"))
ended_careers <- ending_status |>
  inner_join(last_position, by = "playerId") |>
  filter(position_group %in% pos_levels, last_season <= complete_through) |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(position_group, pos_levels))
finished_careers <- ended_careers |>
  filter(career_end != "right_censored") |>
  mutate(with_line = playerId %in% stat_ids)
statline <- finished_careers |> filter(with_line)

ending_labels <- c(
  early_stop = "Stopped with eligibility left",
  eligibility_exhausted = "Used up eligibility",
  eligibility_unknown = "Stopped, eligibility unknown",
  transferred_then_stopped = "Changed schools, then stopped",
  signed_udfa = "Signed undrafted",
  drafted = "Drafted"
)
endings_by_pos <- statline |>
  count(position_group, career_end) |>
  group_by(position_group) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(ending = factor(ending_labels[career_end], ending_labels))
statline_share <- finished_careers |>
  group_by(position_group) |>
  summarise(
    finished = n(),
    with_line = mean(with_line),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# The early stop against each position's next most common ending.
comparison <- early_stop_comparison(statline) |>
  mutate(
    bar = factor(
      bar,
      c("Next most common ending", "Stopped with eligibility left")
    ),
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s, %s: %s",
      position_group,
      ending_labels[career_end],
      pct(share)
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(comparison, aes(
  x = share,
  y = forcats::fct_rev(position_group),
  fill = bar
)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(position_group, career_end)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      `Stopped with eligibility left` = "#374151",
      `Next most common ending` = "#9CA3AF"
    ),
    breaks = c("Stopped with eligibility left", "Next most common ending"),
    labels = c("Early stop", "Next most common ending")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Is an early stop the most common ending at every position?",
    subtitle = "Share of finished stat-line careers, by how they ended",
    x = "Share of finished stat-line careers",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "early-stop-by-position", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-season-figure
# The same comparison by the career's last season, so one season does not
# carry the position's share.
game_window <- 2016:complete_through
by_last <- statline |>
  filter(last_season %in% game_window) |>
  group_by(position_group, last_season) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    early = mean(career_end == "early_stop"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s, last season %s: %s of %s careers stopped with eligibility left",
      position_group,
      last_season,
      pct(early),
      fmt(n)
    )
  )
p_season <- ggplot(
  by_last,
  aes(last_season, early, colour = position_group, group = position_group)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(position_group, last_season)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = game_window) +
  scale_colour_position() +
  labs(
    title = "Is the early-stop share steady across the last seasons?",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Careers whose last season is ",
      min(game_window),
      " to ",
      max(game_window),
      ", by position group"
    ),
    x = "Last season of the career",
    y = "Stopped with eligibility left",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_season)
```

```{r}
#| label: endings-table
endings_by_pos |>
  select(position_group, ending, share) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ending, values_from = share, values_fill = 0) |>
  left_join(statline_share, by = "position_group") |>
  arrange(position_group) |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = as.character(position_group),
    `Finished careers` = fmt(finished),
    `With a stat line` = pct(with_line, 0),
    `Stat-line careers` = fmt(round(finished * with_line)),
    !!!rlang::syms(unname(ending_labels))
  ) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(unname(ending_labels)), \(x) pct(x, 0))) |>
  kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Position group",
      "Finished careers",
      "With a stat line",
      "Stat-line careers",
      unname(ending_labels)
    ),
    align = paste0("l", strrep("r", 9)),
    caption = paste0(
      "Finished careers by the position of their last season, through the season ",
      complete_through,
      ", and how the stat-line careers among them ended. Each row of endings sums to 100%."
    )
  )
```
